incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code (Code de commerce), Articles L.210-1 to L.210-10 and L.223-1 to L.223-43 (SARL formation); French Civil Code Articles 1832 to 1844-17 (general company provisions)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Guichet unique des formalités d'entreprises, operated by the Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle (INPI); formal registration with the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) via the competent commercial court registry
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Statuts (articles of association) and the standardized business formalities dossier filed through the Guichet unique, including the M0 declaration and beneficial-owner declaration; publication of a legal announcement in a support habilité
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum capital for a SARL; all cash contributions must be fully paid up upon incorporation and temporarily deposited with a bank or the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations; the capital amount must be adequate for the intended pharmaceutical LNP manufacturing activity and must remain in an escrowed account pending issuance of the bank receipt
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTION: The founding associates and initial manager of the SARL, having reviewed the draft articles and registered office arrangements, unanimously resolve: (1) to subscribe to and take the entire share capital in accordance with the capital allocation table; (2) to approve the temporary deposit of cash contributions and the bank's attestation of receipt; (3) to adopt as the company's registered office the premises at the stated address, designated as the seat of management and official correspondence; (4) to appoint the named candidate as Gérant of the SARL with plenary authority to execute the incorporation filings, open bank accounts, and undertake all operational steps; and (5) to file the complete dossier with the Guichet unique and meet all statutory publication obligations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pre-incorporation legal review and statutory drafting
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: French corporate counsel and, where required, a French notary
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Collect and verify the identity and KYC of each associate and beneficial owner; confirm the legal availability of the registered office; draft the statuts consistent with the SARL standard form; determine the share class and social object focused on LNP vaccine adjuvant manufacturing; appoint the first Gérant; prepare the beneficial-owner declaration and legal announcement text.
required_dossiers: Passport or national ID for each associate and beneficial owner
Registered office lease or provision-of-address agreement
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry or notary questions the draft, correct the statutory inconsistencies, re-certify signatures, and resubmit without lapsing the corporate object.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: French licensed bank or Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary blocked account in the name of the company in formation; present the draft statuts and corporate resolution; wire or deposit the cash contributions from each associate; obtain the attestation de dépôt des fonds as proof of capital contribution; the funds are then escrowed and released only upon RCS registration.
required_dossiers: Cash transfer proof for each associate
Identity documents of the signatories and Gérant
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank rejects the deposit instruction, rectify name discrepancies, provide an updated corporate resolution, or use another intermediary bank; re-document as required.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Public legal announcement and beneficial-owner declaration preparation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Legal announcement journal (support habilité) and Guichet unique portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Publish the avis de constitution in a government-approved legal journal or online platform; include company form, name, capital, registered office, social object, Gérant, and duration; simultaneously complete the corps of the beneficial-owner declaration, notably the individual natural persons ultimately owning or controlling the company.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If publication formatting is non-compliant or statutory mentions are omitted, reissue or republish the corrected announcement and retain proof of republication for the registry.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Electronic filing with the Guichet unique
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INPI Guichet unique (formalités internationales and commercial)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upload the signed statuts, notarized signatures if applicable, announcement proof, bank deposit attestation, Gérant acceptance, registered office agreement, and beneficial-owner declaration; pay the prescribed filing fee; monitor the submission receipt and correct any queries within the requested deadline.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the INPI portal raises an incompleteness query, upload the allowed supplementary pages, replace the deficient signatures, and resubmit through the same ticket to keep the effective date of registration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce / Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval of the Guichet unique dossier, receive the formal RCS entry and the Kbis extract confirming the company existence; obtain the SIREN/SIRET identifiers; register the Gérant with social security and URSSAF; affix the company seal; open the final operating bank account; begin corporate bookkeeping and statutory registers.
required_dossiers: Final Kbis extract registered by the Greffe
Opening deposit release letter from the bank
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Greffe requires corrections, submit an amended application via the Guichet unique; if timing threshold is missed, request the medical continuance and obtain a certificate of late registration from the competent court.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Agence Nationale de Sécurité du Médicament et des produits de santé (ANSM) and the regional health agency (ARS) for the pharmaceutical manufacturing authorization; Direction Régionale de l'Environnement, de l'Aménagement et du Logement (DREAL) for the classified environmental installation
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Autorisation d'ouverture d'établissement pharmaceutique / Manufacturing establishment authorisation for drug substances and intermediates, pursuant to Article L.5124-2 of the French Public Health Code, together with the Good Manufacturing Practice certification for sterile or biological liposomal manufacture

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Inspection des Installations Classées pour la Protection de l'Environnement (DREAL)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: ICPE authorization or registration regime under Rubrique 2940 of the Code de l'environnement; full environmental impact assessment (étude d'impact) is triggered under the authorization regime if capacity thresholds are exceeded; lower-capacity preparation units remain in the 'Enregistrement' or 'Déclaration' category without a full EIA.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater: self-monitoring under Article R.512-28 with limits on COD, BOD5, suspended solids, nitrogen, and phosphorus as set by the pertinent ministerial order; VOCs: comply with the EU Industrial Emissions Directive 2010/75/EU solvent-management plan, with abatement efficiencies of at least 90-99% for high solvent load streams; waste: hazardous waste containers must be segregated, labelled, and delivered to a licensed disposal centre, with a tracking register.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification by the Commission de Sécurité or SDIS for classified facilities; structural load and containment inspection of cleanrooms and pressure vessels; establishment of emergency evacuation and confinement procedures; workplace clearance and baseline occupational health assessment for pharmaceutical biological usage.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP), Ministère de l'Économie, des Finances et de la Souveraineté industrielle et numérique — the French national tax authority responsible for corporate income tax (Impôt sur les Sociétés, IS) and value added tax (Taxe sur la Valeur Ajoutée, TVA). Business-facing portals: impots.gouv.fr (professional online tax space, TVA and IS declarations, VAT refund claims); formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr (Guichet unique électronique for incorporation, statutory registration, and automatic tax-folder creation); Chorus Pro (national electronic invoicing hub). Customs export clearance and export zero-rating substantiation are jointly handled by the Direction Générale des Douanes et Droits Indirects (DGDDI) via the DELTA-X declaration system (douane.gouv.fr).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1 — Incorporation through the single electronic filing portal (Guichet unique, formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr): file the SARL statutes (statuts), registered-office proof, identity and domicile of the gérant(s), shareholding registry, UBO declaration (Articles L561-2 et seq., Code monétaire et financier), and a commencement-of-activity statement. Step 2 — INSEE assigns the statutory identifiers: SIREN (9-digit legal-unit number) and SIRET (14-digit establishment number). Step 3 — DGFiP automatically opens the IS and TVA tax folders and issues the French intra-Community VAT number in the format FR + 11 characters (SIREN plus 2-digit control key); activation of the professional online tax account is confirmed on impots.gouv.fr. Step 4 — A foreign non-EU parent with VAT obligations in France, or a non-resident treasury/principal acting without a French fixed establishment, must appoint a DGFiP-approved fiscal representative (Article 289 A CGI); the SARL itself, being a French-established entity, files its own taxes. Step 5 — The liposomal vaccine-adjuvant/LNP manufacturing scope requires an ANSM (Agence nationale de sécurité du médicament) pharmaceutical establishment licence and, for certain controlled activities, an export authorisation; the tax registration dossier must be cross-referenced with the ANSM operating authorisation. Non-resident corporate shareholders without a French permanent establishment register with the non-resident taxpayer desk (Service des impôts des particuliers non-résidents) for withholding-tax and procedural purposes.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation — The French SARL is an opaque corporate legal entity resident in France by place of effective management and registered office (Article 2 CGI). It is by default subject to Impôt sur les Sociétés (IS) at entity level on worldwide profits: 25% standard headline rate for fiscal years from 2024, with a 15% reduced rate on the first EUR 42,500 of taxable profit for qualifying companies with turnover below EUR 10,000,000. French worldwide taxation applies; a territorial exemption for foreign permanent-establishment profits is not automatic, and treaty relief operates through tax credits. Pass-through treatment is not the default; it is available only upon a special election for family-owned SARLs (Article 239 bis AA CGI). No domestic check-the-box regime exists under French law.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: 1) SARL family pass-through election (Article 239 bis AA CGI): an SARL whose members are natural persons from the same family group may make an irrevocable 5-year option to be taxed under the personal income-tax (IR) transparent regime, with profits taxed at member level. 2) Groupe d'intégration fiscale (tax consolidation, Article 223 A CGI): a French parent holding at least 95% of the SARL's shares may elect to consolidate the SARL's results into a single group IS base filed by the parent. 3) Option for IS by transparent or civil-law entities (Article 206(4) CGI) is available to partnerships but is not needed for the SARL, which is already opaque. 4) Hybrid-mismatch neutralisation (ATAD 1 and 2, implemented by Articles 209 0 B and 212 ter CGI) disallows double-deduction or deduction-without-inclusion outcomes for hybrid transfers, hybrid entities, and hybrid financial instruments; a high-value MNE SARL potentially subject to the Pillar Two GloBE rules (Law no. 2024-364) must evaluate registration of a supplementary tax declaration where group turnover reaches EUR 750,000,000. No US-style check-the-box mechanism exists; the regimes above are the only statutory routes to modify the default entity-level IS treatment.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) — Taxe sur la Valeur Ajoutée (TVA), governed by Articles 256 to 289 of the Code Général des Impôts (CGI), EU Directive 2006/112/EC, and implementing Decree No. 2007-566. A full EU VAT model with multi-rate structure, intra-Community VAT numbers, and a unified OSS/tax-one-stop-shop framework.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Zero de minimis threshold for French-established taxpayers: the SARL must obtain and use a French TVA number from its first taxable transaction in France (Article 286(a) CGI). Simplified VAT filing (régime réel simplifié) applies while annual turnover stays within approximately EUR 840,000 for sales of goods and approximately EUR 254,000 for services; above these ceilings the normal real regime with monthly or quarterly declarations applies. For non-established foreign suppliers selling goods by distance selling into France, registration under French VAT becomes compulsory once their annual distance sales into the EU exceed the EUR 10,000 EU-wide threshold (Article 258 D CGI); for suppliers storing goods in France under consignment/fulfillment-stock models, immediate TVA registration is required from the first transaction, and non-EU suppliers must appoint a DGFiP-approved fiscal representative as required by Article 289 A CGI.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: France's mandatory structured e-invoicing reform (Ordonnance no. 2022-1372 and Decree no. 2022-1299): from 1 September 2026, large and mid-size enterprises must issue and receive electronic invoices; from 1 September 2027, small and micro enterprises (including the SARL class) become fully obliged. Invoices must be transmitted through the DGFiP public portal (Chorus Pro) or through an accredited Partner Dematerialisation Platform (PDP) in a format validating EN 16931 (e.g. Factur-X); transaction-level data must be reported to DGFiP in near real time under the mandatory e-invoicing/e-reporting data flows, including e-reporting for cross-border transactions. France operates a structured digital-invoice model without pre-clearance digital stamping: DGFiP conducts risk-based automated analysis of the transmitted data, requiring maintenance of the annual FEC audit file (Fichier des Écritures Comptables, NF v2 format) and, for intra-Community supplies, the periodic EC Sales List (état récapitulatif de TVA, Article 289 B CGI).

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating is governed by Article 262-I CGI: supplies of goods dispatched or transported by the seller or for its account to a destination outside the European Union are exempt with credit for input VAT (zero-rated) provided (i) a French/EU export customs declaration (Déclaration Administrative Unique, DAU) is lodged through DELTA-X in the name and tax account of the exporting SARL, (ii) the goods physically leave the EU customs territory within the statutory deadline, and (iii) the exporter holds the Export Accompanying Document (EAD) and third-party proof of exit (bill of lading or air waybill) within three months. Directly related services — quality-control testing, microfluidic encapsulation support, cold-chain logistics, freight forwarding, and international transport services connected to the exported liposomal vaccine-adjuvant/LNP materials — qualify under Article 262-I-2° read with Article 259 CGI. Deliveries to EU VAT-registered customers are not zero-rated but are intra-Community supplies exempt with right to deduction under Article 262 ter CGI, conditional on the customer's TVA number, EC Sales List reporting, and adequate delivery proof. Input VAT on phospholipids, mRNA payloads, buffers, cleanroom capital equipment, and subcontract processing is creditable via the ordinary monthly TVA returns or the annual credit-refund procedure (remboursement de crédit de TVA) before the DGFiP.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Export customs declaration archived in DELTA-X (Déclaration Administrative Unique — DAU) together with the Export Accompanying Document (EAD) and the Movement Reference Number (MRN)
Commercial invoice and packing list issued by the exporting SARL, matching the customs statistical value and stated Incoterms
Bill of Lading (B/L) or Air Waybill (AWB) evidencing physical exit of the goods from the EU customs territory

Inward remittance certificate or bank credit-confirmation package (SWIFT MT103 pairing with the invoice, or equivalent banque de France payment-reporting evidence) proving receipt of export proceeds in the invoiced currency
Certificate of origin (EUR.1, ATR, or Registered-Exporter REX statement) where a preferential tariff origin claim is made at the EU border

ANSM export authorisation (autorisation d'exportation) under the Code de la santé publique for vaccine-adjuvant and lipid-nanoparticle pharmaceutical materials, where applicable to the specific shipment
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Export zero-rating is a priority audit axis for both DGFiP and DGDDI. The SARL must preserve the full export file — EAD/MRN, physical exit proofs, commercial contracts, and payment evidence — for at least six years (Article L102 B, Livre des procédures fiscales), with the audit right extended to ten years where activity was concealed or fraud is established (Article L169 LPF). If the administration recharacterises an alleged export as a domestic taxable supply because proof is insufficient or the export documents are fabricated, it immediately assesses TVA at 20% together with late-payment interest of 0.20% per month (Article 1727 CGI); deliberate inaccuracies attract the 40% penalty (Article 1729-1 CGI), and fraudulent maneuvers or abuse of law attract the 80% penalty (Article 1729-2 CGI). Failure-to-file and obstruction penalties under Article 1728 CGI range from 10% to 40%. Refunds of input VAT credit obtained through fabricated export files are clawed back with interest and penalties, and the case may be referred to the criminal court for tax fraud under Article 1741 CGI (fine up to EUR 500,000 and imprisonment up to five years). On the customs side, false declarations and irregular export documentation engage Articles 414, 426, and 435-436 of the Code des douanes: fines of one to five times the sums evaded, seizure of the goods or their value, suspension or withdrawal of exporter authorisations, and imprisonment up to five years in aggravated cases. A failure to repatriate export proceeds within the 180-day statutory window constitutes a monetary customs infraction under Articles L151-1 et seq. of the Code monétaire et financier and Article 459 du Code des douanes, exposing the SARL to a customs fine equal to 100% of the non-repatriated amount, in addition to any tax reassessment.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France (Bank of France) together with the Direction Générale du Trésor (French Treasury) as the foreign exchange administration and balance-of-payments reporting authority.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France is part of the eurozone and maintains full convertibility for both current-account and capital-account transactions under EU treaty law on free movement of capital. Profit remittance is unrestricted; practical hurdles are limited to standard tax withholding procedures, financial sanctions screening, and anti-money-laundering declarations.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: There is no statutory surrender obligation and no mandatory conversion ratio for export receipts in France. French exporters may retain foreign currency proceeds in authorised accounts, but must declare cross-border flows exceeding notification thresholds to Banque de France for statistical and monetary monitoring purposes.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Crédit Agricole Corporate and Investment Bank

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium feasibility for ancillary payment services only when the fintech holds an EU/EEA electronic money institution licence passported into France or a French ACPR licence. Offshore digital EMIs without a European passport are legally unable to maintain French domestic accounts or provide treasury services to a high-risk pharmaceutical SARL. They are not viable as a primary clearing rail for capital escrow or commercial letters of credit.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: French AML law and ACPR practical guidance require physical interview procedures for entities engaged in regulated pharmaceutical and biotechnology manufacturing. Remote opening may be accepted for simple low-risk accounts, but the ISIC 2100 liposomal vaccine adjuant business scope will trigger mandatory face-to-face review of at least two beneficial owners or statutory managers, or a representative with notarised powers.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Regulated pharmaceutical manufacturing involving advanced nanoparticle and lipid emulsion technology
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Valid ANSM / French National Medicines Agency establishment licence, laboratory technology qualification documents, detailed manufacturing premises inspection report, validated production SOPs, and environmental/safety compliance permits.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Complex cross-border ownership structure with non-resident shareholders
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Corporate ownership chart, Kbis extract, UBO declarations for all natural-person beneficial owners, passport copies with notarised translations, source-of-wealth for initial capital injection, PEP and sanctions screening reports, and clean legal/criminal record evidence.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High volume of cross-border capital injections and trade disbursements without an audited history
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Twelve months of pro-forma financial statements, target-market distribution agreements, purchase orders under LCs, statutory auditor attestation, bank reference letters, and a fully sourced funds flow narrative for every inbound and outbound wire above EUR 15,000.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound equity injections arrive by SWIFT MT103 or MT202 through TARGET2 and the eurozone correspondent network. Each wire must carry the Banque de France balance-of-payments statistical classification code for direct investment equity transfers (with country code FR and the ultimate beneficial owner identification). Verification is completed with the Kbis extract, capital call documents, source-of-funds attestation, and for amounts exceeding statutory thresholds, prior written economic/financial reporting to Banque de France.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound settlements for raw lipid excipients, microfluidic consumables, and vaccine adjuvants are executed via SWIFT MT103 direct payment under ISPA/TARGET2 for EUR, or through commercial documentary credits under UCP600, communicated via SWIFT MT700/MT799. SEPA is used only for EEA counterparties; all non-EEA trade payments must clear via SWIFT/TARGET2 so that reference data and compliance screening are preserved.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: EUR/USD outright forward contracts under a standard ISDA 2002 master agreement
EUR/USD FX options allowing optional hedge execution for procurement and sales commitments
Cross-currency swaps between EUR and USD for long-term foreign currency working capital needs
Non-deliverable forwards limited to non-convertible emerging market currency sub-exposures arising from third-country transshipment transactions

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Liasse fiscale – annual corporate income tax return (Form 2065 with 2050-series annexes)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For FY ending 31-Dec-2025: second working day after 1 May 2026 (Monday 4 May 2026); non-calendar year-end: second working day after 30 April of the following year; short first fiscal year: within 3 months of closing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-payment interest of 0.20% per month from due date (Art. 1727 CGI); 10% surcharge after 30 days (Art. 1728 CGI); 5% late-filing penalty and 40% penalty for deliberately inaccurate returns on assessed tax (Art. 1729 CGI); automatic tax assessment and enforced recovery; persistent non-filing allows the tax authority to petition for judicial winding-up, but does not by itself trigger RCS strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual financial statements filing at the commercial registry (dépôt des comptes annuels: bilan, compte de résultat, annexe)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de commerce / INPI electronic registry portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Shareholders' approval of accounts no later than 30 June 2026 (within 6 months of FY end); filing at the registry within 1 month of approval; absolute filing deadline 31 July 2026 for a 31-Dec-2025 year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Registry issues a formal notice (mise en demeure); continued failure is punishable under Art. L.232-2 and L.241-5 Code de commerce by a fine of up to EUR 2,000 per manager and up to EUR 8,000 per legal entity; after three consecutive years of missing annual filings, the public prosecutor can apply to the commercial court for administrative strike-off (radiation) and judicial dissolution.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial-owner register (RBE) annual confirmation and update declaration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de commerce / INPI – Registre des Bénéficiaires Effectifs (RBE)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Declaration must be updated within 30 days of any change in direct or indirect ownership above 25% or change of control; at each annual accounts filing the beneficial-owner data must be confirmed as current through the electronic S3P portal; a voluntary certificate of no change may be filed annually
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fine of up to EUR 7,500 for natural persons and EUR 75,000 for legal entities; the registry may reject the annual accounts filing until the beneficial-owner declaration is corrected; conviction also triggers exclusion from public procurement for up to 5 years.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Cotisation Foncière des Entreprises (CFE) local business-rate annual roll and payment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFIP) – local tax office (Service des Impôts des Entreprises)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Tax notice issued in December of the assessment year; balance payable by 15 December 2026; if the annual CFE exceeds EUR 3,000, an instalment of 50% is due by 15 June 2026; Form 1447-C-SD must be filed only in the first year of liability or upon a change of place of business
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: 10% late-payment surcharge plus monthly late-payment interest of 0.20%; forced recovery against corporate assets; non-payment does not trigger RCS strike-off but may lead to garnishment and property seizure.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Statutory audit (Commissaire aux Comptes) is mandatory for a French SARL when it exceeds at least two of three thresholds at fiscal year-end: total balance-sheet assets above EUR 4,000,000 (approx. US$ 4.3 million); net turnover above EUR 8,000,000 (approx. US$ 8.6 million); and average workforce above 50 employees during the fiscal year. A pharmaceutical / LNP active-ingredient manufacturer of this scope accordingly exceeds the thresholds and is subject to a mandatory independent audit under Art. L.232-1 and L.616-1 et seq. Code de commerce.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: French GAAP – Plan Comptable Général (PCG) codified in ANC Regulation 2014-03, including the annual balance sheet, profit-and-loss account, and annex; mandatory for the individual statutory financial statements of a SARL; IFRS applies only to consolidated financial statements of groups or listed entities and is not required for the SARL standalone filing.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: France maintains a Registre des Bénéficiaires Effectifs at the commercial registry covering any individual holding more than 25% of share capital or exercising control; the declaration is filed at incorporation and updated within 30 days of any triggering change; no separate stand-alone annual UBO form is imposed, but the annual accounts filing workflow on the INPI/S3P portal requires confirmation that the beneficial-owner declaration remains current; an annual no-change confirmation may be attached voluntarily.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Registre des décisions d'associés – register of shareholder meetings and resolutions (minute book)
Registre des mouvements de parts sociales – register of shares/part transfers and ownership changes
Feuilles de présence et procès-verbaux d'assemblées – attendance sheets and signed minutes of general meetings

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: US$ 450–1,300 per year (EUR 420–1,200) for commercial domiciliation services; Paris-Ile-de-France life-science clusters and law-firm domiciliation typically range from US$ 1,200–2,200 per year
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: US$ 8,500–21,500 per year (EUR 8,000–20,000); an LNP vaccine-adjuvant manufacturer with GMP inventory and transfer-pricing documentation should budget US$ 12,000–18,000 per annual audit cycle

stage_6.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Statutory tax holidays or preferential deductions
